purpose: Isolate generation-bank randomness at fixed detector seed, slots and exposure
baseline_identity: new user-authorized rebuild; not recovered historical checkpoint
slot_order: ascending SHA256 of canonical JSON [class,source_id,conditioning_id,annotation_index]; lexical canonical key breaks any hash tie
conditioning_policy: unchanged baseline normal pool/filter; choose once without scores, freeze before noise banks
paired_exclusions: structural/numerical failures only; same excluded slot IDs in every bank; no replacement slots
realrepeat: full original real image and full original labels; extra class-role draw counts equal surviving bank class counts; no target isolation
training_order: same base identities, synthetic slot identities, positional shuffle rule in VA/VB/VC; audit actual delivered order, including augmentation exposure separately
validation: only after ALL four arms finish; one evaluation of epoch150 last.pt per arm; no best.pt selection
std_definition: sample std, ddof=1 across three generation banks; fixed detector seed, not detector-seed uncertainty
